title: 1987 AMC 8 Problem 18
statement: Half the people in a room left. One third of those remaining started to dance. There were then \(12\) people who were not dancing. What was the original number of people in the room?

solutions.text:
Of those remaining, \(\dfrac13\) danced, so \(\dfrac23\) did not. Thus \(\dfrac23\) of the remaining people equals \(12,\) giving \(18\) remaining.

Those \(18\) are half the original group, so the room started with \(2 \times 18 = 36\) people.

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: After half leave, the number remaining is what the dancing fraction applies to
The \(12\) non-dancers are \(\dfrac23\) of those remaining
